clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from years of experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: An OEM Authorization Certificate must be uploaded by the seller.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming experience or turnover exemption must upload supporting documents.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail M /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 1500000
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 15,00,000 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers (goods) or service providers are exempt from EMD; traders are not.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents with the bid.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: OEM average turnover relaxation applies only if the MSE bidder is itself the OEM of the offered products.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: The bidder seeking Relaxation from Turnover shall upload the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for Relaxation.
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking turnover relaxation must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
clauses.quote: Bidders are required to submit OEM certificate/Authorization certificate f rom OEM along with this bid. In case bidder quote goods of more than one OEM then MAF is required from all different OEM.
clauses.summary: Bidders must submit OEM authorization from every OEM whose goods are quoted.

clauses.heading: Instruction for submission of Bid Security (EMD)
clauses.quote: The bidder, who will submit their EMD (Bid Security) in form of DD / Bank Guarantee (BG) through speed post / courier are requested to kindly superscribed the envelope with the following details:
clauses.summary: EMD submitted physically as DD or BG must be sent in a superscribed envelope with bid details.
